Third-party driver: VB-Audio VB-CABLE
Official origin: https://vb-audio.com/Cable/
VB-CABLE is donationware; all contributions are welcome. Licensing details:
https://vb-audio.com/Services/licensing.htm
Super Audio Control is not affiliated with VB-Audio. The driver is distributed
as an optional component; its installer is launched only after the user's explicit
request and Windows administrator approval.
